reviews.text: This company was professional from start to finish. The subcontractors who worked on my home were experienced professionals who treated my home like it was their own. Our project manager, Marcus, spent time talking to us about colors and product quality that sped up our HOA approval and saved us money on our Homeowner's Insurance moving forward. This GC is the PEAK of customer service a product quality!
reviews.author: Randy Bilyeu

reviews.text: It was an amazing experience to get my roof replaced by Peak roofing. Ricardo was very proactive in understanding my needs, explaining to me the whole process and the many items which go into the work. His crew did a professional, fast and complete job of roof replacement with everything put as agreed upon. Post payment too, Ricardo ensures I got the photos and the certificate to help me with requirements of Insurance company. I highly recommend Ricardo and Peak roofing.
reviews.author: Mahendra Jha

reviews.text:
Peak Roofing and Construction got my house in better condition than it was before the hail storm!

Marcus Davis guided us through every step of the process.  He came and met with the adjuster, making sure they noted ALL the damage.  He helped with the insurance process.  The repair process was seamless.

Marcus and his team were ALWAYS there when they said they would be.

They ALWAYS made sure we understood what the plan was and communicated well.

They ALWAYS did what they said they would.

I'm a Peak Roofing & Construction fan for life!  You can't go wrong with these guys!
reviews.author: Nathan McGregor

reviews.text: Marcus and Peak were great from start to finish! Marcus communicated everything effectively, did everything he promised, and made sure to accommodate all details with minimal effort from us. He is very personable, professional, and is doing the hail restoration at my brother’s and mom’s house as well because he is so great at what he does. He walks you through the entire process, and all of the crews that he coordinated were professional, efficient, transparent and reliable.  I will be using them for any other future roofing and restoration needs and can’t recommend them enough!
reviews.author: Nick Mcgregor

reviews.text: Peak Roofing is amazing! Micheal Gray was fantastic … we called them out to check our roof after a storm and Micheal and the owner came out and did an inspection on our roof. The did not nickel and dime and told us what was only recommended. They were professional and kept constant communication throughout the repairs. Micheal checked in and came out to make sure repairs were done correctly and nothing was missed. I will recommend Peak Roofing to all my friends and family and will be using them for any repairs from here on out! Great job Peak Roofing!
reviews.author: jennifer yandell

reviews.text: Sooo impressed with the service we got from Blake who came out to examine the leak we had.  He was so polite, professional and showed a real concern for the problem we had.  It did not take him long at all to identify where the problem was and then promptly proceeded to fix it on the spot.  Since that time we have a number of good rainstorms with no leaking whatsoever and he even checked back with us a few days later to make sure the problem was resolved.  I can highly recommend Peak and especially Blake their technician . I would not hesitate ever to use them again and will gladly refer them to anyone in need of professional roofers.  Thank you Peak and Blake..so glad we found you.
reviews.author: Karen Walker

reviews.text:
I’ve been doing a lot of work on my mother’s house to get it ready to sell, which means dealing with many vendors—and too often, you reach out and never hear back. Jimmy Smith with Peak Roofing and Construction brought customer service back just when I thought it was lost forever.

From the very start, Jimmy was proactive. He came out quickly, did a full inspection, and gave me an honest assessment. He guided me through the HOA approval process and even helped me navigate insurance, which was a huge relief. He worked within budget and tight deadlines to make sure everything was completed in time for our closing date.

Jimmy also brought out a fantastic crew who were fast, professional, and did excellent work. I had my own roof replaced a few years ago with another company and left a negative review because of that experience—this was the complete opposite. Thanks to Jimmy and the Peak Roofing team, the process was smooth, stress-free, and done right.

I highly recommend Jimmy Smith and Peak Roofing and Construction.
reviews.author: Paul Donaghy

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Peak Roofing for a roof replacement, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. From start to finish, the process was seamless and efficient. Charlie Gray provided exceptional customer service, ensuring that all our questions were answered and that we felt confident every step of the way.

The team at Peak Roofing worked quickly without compromising on quality. Our new roof looks fantastic and has already withstood a few storms with no issues. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication to high-quality workmanship truly stood out.

I highly recommend Peak Roofing to anyone in need of roof replacement services. They deliver fast, top-notch results with outstanding customer care. Five stars all the way!
reviews.author: Greg Appel
